origin.meaning: Local source origin at the point on the loop nearest the venue coordinate, after rotation to the start.

native_station_frame.side_convention: Driver left/right in forward lap direction; geographic footprints retain source east/north coordinates.

review.method: Viewed every frame of overview and detail contact sheets. Sparse review of edited gameplay; rear cameras, menus and cuts are excluded as metric geometry evidence.

sectors.name: Pit straight and T1–2
sectors.observed: Grandstand/pit temporary structures and monumental city facades, broad asphalt channel and tall fencing; trees behind wall, narrow red-white apex kerbs. Escape lanes continue straight at90degree turns.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T2 long city straight
sectors.observed: Landmark tower cluster to right of northern boulevard. Varied pale stone and modern balcony facades, continuous broadleaf trees. Long straight braking boards and uninterrupted wall/fence corridor; do not substitute repeated identical hotels.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T3–4 boulevard corners
sectors.observed: Orthogonal street corners among cream/grey ornamental buildings with cornices, arcade ground floors, park trees and white tents. Museum Centre/Maritime Academy left by native registration. Paved terminal escape needs buffer protection.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T5–7 entry to Old City
sectors.observed: Trees and tightly spaced stone street facades, balconies/windows and varied roofline. Houses sit directly behind fence, public junction markings visible. Slow turns have small red-white kerbs and asphalt escape, not gravel.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Castle T8–12 climb
sectors.observed: Direct234s forward view shows T8approach and left entry with redLenovo barriers.236s shows the narrow castle ramp with rough stone curtain wall/roundturret LEFT and pale façades/catchfence RIGHT.238s is a REAR camera, useful for battlements/turret architecture but not forward corner direction. Preserve the7.6m narrow section and near-zero shoulders.240s is already the upper-city departure.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Upper city T13–15 and downhill
sectors.observed: Palace/classical facades with projecting bays, low park-side stone retaining walls and tall leafy trees. Crest then descending sightline; T15 has a straight-ahead paved escape. Philharmonic/Palace of Happiness give identity beyond castle.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T16 and Old City waterfront edge
sectors.observed: Four Seasons and pale monumental facades, leafy park and stone buildings. Road broadens after slow left; Maiden Tower visible behind inner city. Curving approach toward waterfront should remain continuous.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T17–20 waterfront and long SF return
sectors.observed: Open long boulevard lined by mature broadleaf trees, temporary waterfront stands and varied hotel/glazed skyline. House of Government dominant near SF, low pit structures; straight speed signs and distance boards. Do not place castle facades along entire seafront.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

msc_wall_band_registration.reason: Pre-castle 225 s AzerbaijanGP and 230 s Louis Vuitton appearance disproves the former pre-castle MSC placement. Post-castle 238/240/245 s supports the relocated ranges. This is inferred frame registration, not a surveyed advertising plan.

coastal_water_correction.omission_fixed: The previous venue contained no sea geometry and rendered the coastal scenery grid as Runoff. Actual directed shoreline faces now replace only mapped water, retaining land, buildings and pier footprints.
coastal_water_correction.preservation: Water is appended only to water_shapes, never extra_corridors. Native roads/protection and mapped building/pier land are excluded. Actual coast edges and island holes are retained. Terrain under water is removed; flat water uses the existing Water material. Native road XYZ, widths, bank and physics are untouched.
coastal_water_correction.pier_levels: Actual mapped footprints. Each deck is estimated from retained ground at the closest coastline vertex, with minimum 0.6 m freeboard. These are original scenery reconstructions, not surveyed pier elevations.
coastal_water_correction.reference_visibility: Supplied cockpit sequences reviewed here mostly hide coastal water behind barriers, buildings and trees. They establish context and day/night appearance, not a surveyed sea-camera pair. Direct geographic water context comes from the official aerial/map listed below. Off-axis absence from a cockpit still is not evidence that water is missing.
coastal_water_correction.next_gate: Fresh source generation/import and complete packaged live lap with Luna High. Source topology and height proofs are not rendered acceptance.

vertical_registration.datum_note: Caspian absolute altitude is not a native relative altitude. Scenery DSM uses factual F1SFdatum via scenery-ground.json, replacing incompatible oldmedianroof rebase. Waterlevel2025 is not a precise game-reference epoch measurement.

scenery_datum_correction.type: Same retained GLO-90 DSM scenery, not bare earth. Existing 20 m near-road joins retained; no coastal mask or incompatible vertical datums.
scenery_datum_correction.effects: 384 racing-deck and edge probes change 0 m. Farther building-centroid ground usually rises 4.232 m; near-road building centroids change 0–3.79 m under existing ground joins. No relief rescaling.
scenery_datum_correction.uncertainty: F1 profile and historical Caspian water epochs are approximate. Dataset still includes roofs and canopy. Native car profiles remain exactly unchanged.

primary_visual_context.supports: Viewed official 2024 operator map: Caspian Sea below the boulevard, actual pier platforms and wider coastal park separating the racing street from water. Map corroborates shape/dry pier controls; exact shoreline comes from retained OSM ways.

supplied_context_frames.observed: Actual long straight with dense park trees toward sea; water occluded, not a direct sea view.
